mentions.name: Higher Scores DFS
mentions.description: An educational site that helps Daily Fantasy Sports fans improve their DraftKings and FanDuel gameplay. It offers strategy advice, player tips, optimized lineups, and player props, supports both classic and showdown games, and includes a section with game outcome predictions for people doing sports trading on prediction markets. It currently covers the NFL, NBA, and MLB.
mentions.audience: Daily Fantasy Sports fans playing on DraftKings and FanDuel

mentions.name: Higher Scores DFS
mentions.description: This app uses predictive AI (PyTorch and scikit-learn) to predict professional sports athlete outcomes for DFS fans. It offers strategy advice, hot player tips, optimized lineups, and pick'em-style game-friendly player props, doing the number crunching so fans can make better decisions while staying in control of their play.
mentions.problem: DFS fans want support in making better decisions about predicting professional sports athlete outcomes, without giving up control; the app handles the number crunching so they can focus on competitive, fun play.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on an app that uses old-school predictive AI (i.e. pytorch and scikit-learn) to predict professional sports outcomes in a way that is useful for DFS fans. Here is the landing page.
